preserved_core_architecture: Reference LP -> Scene Evidence -> Creative Mechanism -> Compatibility / Constraint -> Combination Recipe -> Scene Spec

archetype_sampling_allocation.rationale: High-frequency local lead generation with strong transfer value across construction, home and place-based services.
archetype_sampling_allocation.saturation_stop_rule: Stop below target after two consecutive batches add no new supported mechanism or conversion pattern; continue toward upper bound when new independent local-trust mechanisms recur.

archetype_sampling_allocation.rationale: Large decision size and objection density require broad proof, mobile and decision-sequence coverage.
archetype_sampling_allocation.saturation_stop_rule: Stop when objection/proof combinations saturate across two industries; extend within upper bound for distinct financing, inspection or consultation flows.

archetype_sampling_allocation.rationale: Trust, authority and disclosure patterns recur across regulated and expert-led services.
archetype_sampling_allocation.saturation_stop_rule: Stop when authority/proof/disclosure mechanisms repeat across three independent industries; extend for materially different decision-risk states.

archetype_sampling_allocation.rationale: Regulated claims, sensitive states and accessibility require deliberate coverage beyond market frequency.
archetype_sampling_allocation.saturation_stop_rule: Do not stop before claim-safety and accessibility variants are observed across clinic, treatment and wellness contexts; then stop on mechanism saturation.

archetype_sampling_allocation.rationale: High visual diversity and before/after claim risk make this a distinct validation domain.
archetype_sampling_allocation.saturation_stop_rule: Stop only after before/after, testimonial, appointment and claim-limitation patterns are covered; extend for new evidence-safe presentation mechanisms.

archetype_sampling_allocation.rationale: Complex explanation, proof and technical authority patterns are central to LP automation.
archetype_sampling_allocation.saturation_stop_rule: Stop when technical proof and explanation mechanisms recur across at least three industries; extend for new buyer committee or deployment states.

archetype_sampling_allocation.rationale: Specification-led products need document-heavy and product-proof coverage with low motion dependence.
archetype_sampling_allocation.saturation_stop_rule: Stop after specification, application, compliance and inquiry paths are represented across independent suppliers; extend for novel product proof.

archetype_sampling_allocation.rationale: High LP usage and varied trial, demo, signup and workflow explanation patterns.
archetype_sampling_allocation.saturation_stop_rule: Stop when trial/demo/pricing/onboarding mechanisms saturate across distinct product categories; extend for materially different adoption friction.

archetype_sampling_allocation.rationale: Direct purchase requires broad product proof, offer, merchandising and checkout-intent coverage.
archetype_sampling_allocation.saturation_stop_rule: Stop when product proof, offer, social proof and purchase-friction mechanisms recur across categories; extend for new product risk states.

archetype_sampling_allocation.rationale: Place, menu/product presentation and reservation/order paths are common and visually diverse.
archetype_sampling_allocation.saturation_stop_rule: Stop when reservation, ordering, place and menu mechanisms recur across independent venues; extend for new service-context patterns.

archetype_sampling_allocation.rationale: Trust, fit, outcomes and enrollment decisions require a dedicated consideration model.
archetype_sampling_allocation.saturation_stop_rule: Stop when course, school, coaching and trial/enrollment patterns saturate; extend for new learner or guardian decision states.

archetype_sampling_allocation.rationale: Two-sided persuasion and people evidence create mechanisms not represented by ordinary service LPs.
archetype_sampling_allocation.saturation_stop_rule: Stop when candidate, employer, culture and role-proof mechanisms recur across sectors; extend for new audience asymmetries.

archetype_sampling_allocation.rationale: Authority, scarcity, craft and restrained conversion patterns supply high-value creative combinations.
archetype_sampling_allocation.saturation_stop_rule: Stop when premium proof, scarcity, appointment and editorial mechanisms recur across independent brands; extend for new authority bases.

archetype_sampling_allocation.rationale: Smaller conversion share but high mechanism diversity and transfer value for campaigns and launches.
archetype_sampling_allocation.saturation_stop_rule: Stop when campaign, participation, release and editorial mechanisms saturate; extend only for a new interaction or participation model.

archetype_sampling_allocation.rationale: Brand-heavy references are needed for authority and narrative systems without allowing them to dominate conversion evidence.
archetype_sampling_allocation.saturation_stop_rule: Stop when corporate narrative, capability proof and stakeholder navigation mechanisms recur across sectors; extend for new stakeholder structures.

archetype_sampling_allocation.rationale: Lower LP frequency but critical accessibility, public-trust and high-stakes communication coverage.
archetype_sampling_allocation.saturation_stop_rule: Do not stop before accessibility-critical, multilingual, public-service and social-proof patterns are covered; then stop on mechanism saturation.

reference_pool_types.selection_rule: Original or official evidence, observable conversion architecture, feasibility and mobile review required
Creative mechanism and transfer job must be explicit; award status alone is insufficient

authority_rule: Evidence Authority answers what makes the claim or visual credible. Expression Driver answers how attention, mood or reading behavior is shaped. They must be retrieved and scored separately.

candidate_to_supported.archetype_scope: If only one archetype is supported, scope must be explicit

scoring.normalization_formula: normalized_category_score = SUM((raw_dimension_score / 5) * dimension_weight for OBSERVED applicable dimensions) / SUM(dimension_weight for OBSERVED applicable dimensions) * category_target_max; NOT_APPLICABLE dimensions are excluded; MISSING and NOT_OBSERVED dimensions are not silently converted to zero
scoring.overall_formula: overall_score = SUM(applicable category scores) / SUM(target_max for applicable categories) * 100; a category with no applicable dimensions is excluded from the denominator

meaning.REQUIRED: The dimension is necessary for the selected pool, scene or evaluation purpose.
meaning.OPTIONAL: The dimension may be absent without implying low quality; score it only when observed.
meaning.NOT_APPLICABLE: The dimension has no legitimate job for this reference and is excluded from the score.

meaning.OBSERVED: The relevant scene or behavior was captured and can be scored.
meaning.MISSING: The dimension is expected or required but the reference has no usable evidence or asset.
meaning.NOT_OBSERVED: The observation was not completed yet; this is a HOLD state, not a quality score.
meaning.NOT_APPLICABLE: The dimension is explicitly inapplicable and does not enter the denominator.

dimension_applicability.missingness_policy: MISSING on a hard-gate dimension fails promotion; NOT_OBSERVED creates HOLD; OPTIONAL missingness is recorded and cannot be treated as positive evidence; NOT_APPLICABLE is excluded.
dimension_applicability.motion_policy: Motion and Interaction default to OPTIONAL. A static reference is not penalized for absence. If a Motion Mechanism Evidence record is asserted, Motion dimensions become REQUIRED for that evidence record and the pool-specific motion threshold applies.

conversion_architecture.meaning: Observable conversion design structure, not measured CVR or revenue performance

scoring.hard_gate_dimension_policy: Only dimensions listed by the applicable pool promotion rule are hard gates; there is no global minimum_raw_dimension_score across every dimension.

design_distinctiveness_rule.design_distinctiveness: 0 = generic / highly template-like, 5 = clearly authored and distinctive

conversion_architecture_policy.performance_evidence_allowed_only_when: Official case study or public measurement with source, metric, period, population and methodology is available

observed_performance_evidence_schema.claim_rule: Performance may be stored as reported evidence, never inferred from visual observation

creative_profile.axis_value_rule: Axis values require input evidence and a derivation rule. Missing evidence produces UNKNOWN, not a guessed low or high value.

numeric_derivation_policy.axis_score_formula: weighted_mean(contribution for distinct evidence classes); quantize to nearest allowed numeric value; fewer than one DIRECT or SUPPORTING contribution with score >= 0.25 yields UNKNOWN
numeric_derivation_policy.quantization_tie_rule: Exact midpoint rounds to the lower allowed value; retain UNKNOWN when evidence is absent or only IRRELEVANT.
numeric_derivation_policy.conflicting_evidence_rule: Score each evidence class independently, then use the weighted mean. If the highest and lowest DIRECT evidence contributions differ by >= 0.50, cap the axis at 0.50 and set confidence to LOW; an explicit current official fact overrides older or generic evidence only when recency is documented.
numeric_derivation_policy.unknown_policy: UNKNOWN is distinct from numeric 0. Use UNKNOWN when relevant evidence is absent, not observed, stale without a recency rule, or irreconcilably conflicting.

axes.derivation_rule: Increase only when independently verifiable trust signals are present and relevant to the buyer risk.
axes.confidence_rule: High requires two evidence classes; medium one direct class; otherwise low or UNKNOWN.

axes.derivation_rule: Increase when the business truth exposes repeatable skill, process or material decisions.
axes.confidence_rule: High requires direct process or material evidence.
axes.unknown_policy: Use UNKNOWN when craft is asserted but not shown.

axes.derivation_rule: Increase when place materially changes the service, trust or customer experience.
axes.confidence_rule: High requires official place evidence plus service relevance.
axes.unknown_policy: Do not infer locality from a Japanese address alone.

axes.derivation_rule: Increase only when price, audience, channel or official positioning jointly support a premium posture.
axes.confidence_rule: High requires at least two direct evidence classes.
axes.unknown_policy: No luxury language from visual taste alone.

axes.derivation_rule: Increase when the business truth indicates speed, activity, change or participation.
axes.confidence_rule: High requires observable behavior, not color preference.
axes.unknown_policy: Do not use energetic expression to compensate for missing business energy.

axes.derivation_rule: Increase when technical complexity is a real buyer concern and is evidenced by documents or process.
axes.unknown_policy: Do not equate dark UI with technicality.

axes.derivation_rule: Increase when human care or relational behavior is evidenced.
Increase only when a new method or category position is evidenced.
axes.unknown_policy: No innovation claim from unusual visual design.

axes.derivation_rule: Increase when named people or direct human interaction is central to the offer.
axes.unknown_policy: Do not use stock people as proof of human authority.

axes.derivation_rule: Increase when the company has relevant, verifiable authority for the buyer decision.
axes.unknown_policy: Never substitute award prestige for business authority.

axes.derivation_rule: Increase when editing and sequencing are necessary to make the offer understood.
axes.confidence_rule: Based on information structure, not serif typography.
axes.unknown_policy: Use neutral structure when no editorial need exists.

axes.derivation_rule: Increase when play is consistent with the audience and conversion job.
axes.confidence_rule: High requires a real participation or campaign reason.
axes.unknown_policy: Do not add play to make a weak offer interesting.

axes.derivation_rule: Increase when accuracy and repeatability are customer-relevant and evidenced.
axes.confidence_rule: High requires measurable or procedural evidence.
axes.unknown_policy: No precision inference from geometric decoration.

axes.derivation_rule: Increase when the business openly defines cost, scope, boundaries or next steps.
axes.confidence_rule: High requires at least two concrete disclosures.
axes.unknown_policy: Do not claim transparency when key conditions are unknown.

axes.derivation_rule: Increase when the buyer must feel personally understood or protected.
axes.unknown_policy: Do not confuse small business size with intimacy.

axes.derivation_rule: Increase only when a factual time condition changes the decision.
axes.confidence_rule: High requires dated or operational evidence.

definitions.E1: Award, gallery or portfolio description without original-page verification
definitions.E2: Original or official live page verified
definitions.E3: Original or official page plus desktop and mobile snapshot review
definitions.E4: E3 plus multi-scene mechanism evidence and source-backed transfer note

storage_policy.archive_location: Versioned object storage bucket with immutable, content-addressed evidence objects; bounded CI artifacts are secondary transfer caches only
storage_policy.storage_backend: S3-compatible versioned object storage with Object Lock/WORM retention for the evidence namespace; provider credentials and bucket name are configured outside the repository
storage_policy.retention: 24 months from captured_at for Pilot evidence, then renew or mark EXPIRED; Strong/Deep evidence is retained while the record is canonical or until rights/retention policy requires removal
storage_policy.expiration_policy: An expired or deleted object cannot be the sole evidence for E2-E4; downgrade the evidence record to HOLD/E1 as appropriate and surface it in the recapture queue.
storage_policy.re_capture_policy: Re-capture when the URL changes, the object expires, the content hash changes, the page is materially redesigned, or evidence is needed for a promotion decision; preserve the old metadata and create a new captured_at/hash record.
storage_policy.ci_artifact_policy: CI artifacts may cache a bounded export for <=90 days and must not be the only retained copy for Strong or Deep records.
storage_policy.reproducibility_rule: A missing archive object changes evidence grade to HOLD; metadata is never treated as visual evidence by itself

CREATIVE_BENCHMARK.conversion_architecture_storage: Observe and store Conversion Architecture Quality when present, but do not apply a required category threshold for Creative Benchmark promotion.
